subproblem.title: The weighted fibre sum (rotational flux density) equals m·t near (1, 0)
subproblem.statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and C ∈ 𝒟_2(ℝ^P) be minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ), with ∂C = 0 and a cone (IsConeCurrent C). Let Q be a 2-dimensional linear subspace of ℝ^P, a, e ∈ Q with |a| = |e| = 1 and ⟨a, e⟩ = 0, δ > 0 and k ∈ ℕ with k ≥ 1. Assume a ∈ spt C and that for all t > 0 and φ ∈ (0, δ) the point y := t(cos φ·a + sin φ·e) satisfies HasMassDensity C y k and spt C ∩ B_r(y) ⊆ Q for some r > 0. Let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an integer multiplicity representation of C, μ := R.measure, m ∈ ℕ with HasMassDensity C a m, and 0 < s ≤ 1/4 such that the localization property Loc(s) holds: for every s' ∈ (0, s] and every x ∈ spt C with ⟨x, a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s', |f(x)| < s' and |x − πx| ≤ 2s|x| one has |x − πx| < (s'/4)|x| and |x − a| < 3s' (π := Q.starProjection, f(x) := arctan(⟨x, e⟩/⟨x, a⟩)). Let T_x := approxTangentPlane 2 M x, Ax := ⟨x, a⟩e − ⟨x, e⟩a, w(x) := |p_{T_x}(Ax)|, Z_s := {x : ⟨x, a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s, |f(x)| < s, |x − πx| < s|x|}, F̃(x) := (|x|, f(x)) and H(p) := Σ_{x ∈ M ∩ Z_s ∩ F̃⁻¹{p}} θ(x)·w(x) ∈ [0, ∞] for p ∈ ℝ × ℝ. Then there is s₂ > 0 such that H(p) = m·p_1 (as ENNReal.ofReal (m·p_1)) for Lebesgue-almost every p = (p_1, p_2) ∈ (1 − s₂, 1 + s₂) × (−s₂, s₂).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P) (δ : ℝ) (k : ℕ), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → 0 < δ → 1 ≤ k → a ∈ C.support → (∀ t φ : ℝ, 0 < t → 0 < φ → φ < δ → HasMassDensity C (t • (Real.cos φ • a + Real.sin φ • e)) k ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ C.support ∩ ball (t • (Real.cos φ • a + Real.sin φ • e)) r ⊆ (Q : Set (Euclid P))) → ∀ (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (m : ℕ) (s : ℝ), R.Represents C → HasMassDensity C a m → 0 < s → s ≤ 1 / 4 → (∀ s' : ℝ, 0 < s' → s' ≤ s → ∀ x ∈ C.support, 0 < inner ℝ x a → |‖x‖ - 1| < s' → |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s' → ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ ≤ 2 * s * ‖x‖ → ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s' / 4 * ‖x‖ ∧ dist x a < 3 * s') → ∃ s₂ : ℝ, 0 < s₂ ∧ ∀ᵐ p : ℝ × ℝ, p ∈ Ioo (1 - s₂) (1 + s₂) ×ˢ Ioo (-s₂) s₂ → ∑' x : ↥(R.carrier ∩ {x : Euclid P | 0 < inner ℝ x a ∧ |‖x‖ - 1| < s ∧ |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| < s ∧ ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ < s * ‖x‖} ∩ (fun x : Euclid P => (‖x‖, Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a))) ⁻¹' {p}), (R.mult x : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal ‖(approxTangentPlane 2 R.carrier (x : Euclid P)).starProjection (inner ℝ (x : Euclid P) a • e - inner ℝ (x : Euclid P) e • a)‖ = ENNReal.ofReal ((m : ℝ) * p.1)
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: parent steps 6–10 (conservation law, fibres, H depends only on t, H = ct, c = m), assembled from the sibling results. Conventions: H² := μHE[2]; μ = θ·H²⌞M, θ ≥ 1 on M, so H²(M ∩ S) ≤ μ(S) for Borel S and μ ≪ H²⌞M; q(x) := x − πx; Ax := ⟨x,a⟩e − ⟨x,e⟩a; Ω := {⟨x,a⟩ > 0}; T_x := approxTangentPlane 2 M x, p_{T_x} its orthogonal projection; w(x) := |p_{T_x}(Ax)|, G(x) := w(x)²/|πx|², J(x) := w(x)/|πx|²; Z(s,s') := {x : ⟨x,a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s', |f(x)| < s', |q(x)| < s|x|}, Z := Z(s,s); F̃(x) := (|x|, f(x)); fibre X(p) := M ∩ Z ∩ F̃⁻¹{p}, H(p) := Σ_{x∈X(p)} θ(x)w(x), N(p) := Σ_{x∈X(p)} θ(x) (tsums in [0, ∞]). (F1) (a, e) is an orthonormal basis of Q, πx = ⟨x,a⟩a + ⟨x,e⟩e. (F2) A is linear with values in Q, ⟨Ax, x⟩ = 0, |Ax| = |πx|, so w ≤ |πx| ≤ |x|, πx ≠ 0 on Ω and 0 ≤ G ≤ 1 there. (F3) On Ω, f is C^∞, |f| < π/2, f(rx) = f(x) (r > 0), and πx = |πx|(cos f(x)·a + sin f(x)·e). (Supp) spt C = μ.support (`Submission.imrep_represents_support_eq_inter_measure_support`, U = univ) and μ((spt C)ᶜ) = 0 (`MeasureTheory.Measure.support_mem_ae`; ℝ^P is second countable). (Uniq) HasMassDensity C a θ and HasMassDensity C a θ' imply θ = θ'. O_s := (1 − s, 1 + s) × (−s, s).
0. (Inputs.) Sibling `Submission.idtp_cse_cone_stationary_radial`: R.firstVariation X = 0 for all C¹ compactly supported X, and p_{T_x}x = x for μ-a.e. x. μ(B_2(0)) < ∞ (locallyIntegrable_mult).
1. (Gap.) For μ-a.e. x (namely x ∈ spt C, by (Supp)): if ⟨x,a⟩ > 0, ||x| − 1| < s and |f(x)| < s then |q(x)| < (s/2)|x| or |q(x)| > 2s|x|; otherwise |q(x)| ≤ 2s|x| and Loc(s) with s' := s gives |q(x)| < (s/4)|x| < (s/2)|x|.
2. (Conservation law.) Sibling `Submission.idtp_cse_rotation_conservation` (hypotheses: frame, 0 < s ≤ 1/4, step 0, step 1): for ψ, l ∈ C¹ with tsupport ψ ⊆ (−s, s) and tsupport l ⊆ (1 − s, 1 + s), x ↦ ψ'(f(x))l(|x|)G(x) is μ-integrable on Z and ∫_Z ψ'(f(x))l(|x|)G(x) dμ = 0.
3. (Area identities.) Sibling `Submission.idtp_cse_fibre_area_identities` (radial tangency from step 0): H is a.e.-measurable and ∫ b·H = ∫_Z b(F̃(x))·G(x) dμ for measurable b : ℝ × ℝ → [0, ∞]. (a) F̃(Z) ⊆ O_s, so X(p) = ∅ and H(p) = 0 for p ∉ O_s. With b ≡ 1, ∫ H = ∫_Z G dμ ≤ μ(Z) ≤ μ(B_2(0)) < ∞ (G ≤ 1 on Z ⊆ Ω, Z ⊆ B_2(0)). Hence H < ∞ a.e., H_ℝ := toReal ∘ H is a.e.-measurable and integrable on ℝ × ℝ (∫|H_ℝ| ≤ ∫ H < ∞), H_ℝ = 0 off O_s, and ofReal(H_ℝ) = H a.e. (b) (Signed identity.) For every bounded Borel b : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ, ∫ b·H_ℝ = ∫_Z b(F̃(x))G(x) dμ(x): apply 3 to ofReal∘b⁺ and ofReal∘b⁻ (b^± := max(±b, 0)); both sides are finite (≤ sup|b|·μ(Z)); G is a.e.-strongly measurable for μ on Z (via `Submission.imrep_approxTangent_starProjection_aesm` and μ ≪ H²⌞M) with 0 ≤ G ≤ 1 on Z; convert each lower integral of a nonnegative integrable function into a Bochner integral (`integral_eq_lintegral_of_nonneg_ae`) and subtract.
4. (Hypothesis (α).) For ψ, l ∈ C¹ with tsupport ψ ⊆ (−s, s), tsupport l ⊆ (1 − s, 1 + s), b(t, α) := ψ'(α)l(t) is bounded and continuous, and F̃(x) = (|x|, f(x)); so by 3(b) and step 2, ∫ ψ'(p_2)·l(p_1)·H_ℝ(p) dp = ∫_Z ψ'(f(x))l(|x|)G(x) dμ = 0.
5. (Scaling.) Let r > 0. (i) By `Submission.cone_current_imrep_measure_smul_image`, μ(r•A) = ofReal(r²)μ(A) for Borel A; hence the image of μ under y ↦ ry is ofReal(r^{−2})·μ (for Borel A, {y : ry ∈ A} = r^{−1}•A, so μ({y : ry ∈ A}) = ofReal(r^{−2})μ(A) by the lemma applied with λ := r^{−1}), and therefore ∫ φ(ry) dμ(y) = r^{−2}∫ φ dμ, i.e. ∫ φ dμ = r²∫ φ(ry) dμ(y), for μ-integrable φ (`integral_map`, `integral_smul_measure`). (ii) By the sibling `Submission.idtp_cse_cone_approxTangent_smul`, T_{ry} = T_y for μ-a.e. y; since A(ry) = rAy and π(ry) = rπy, G(ry) = G(y) for μ-a.e. y. (iii) f(ry) = f(y), and the conditions ⟨y,a⟩ > 0 and |q(y)| < s|y| are invariant under y ↦ ry.
6. (Hypothesis (β).) Let l, ψ ∈ C¹ with tsupport l ⊆ (1 − s/2, 1 + s/2), tsupport ψ ⊆ (−s, s), and |r − 1| < s/4 (so r > 0). Let Z' := {y : ⟨y,a⟩ > 0, |f(y)| < s, |q(y)| < s|y|}. If l(|x|/r) ≠ 0 then |x| ∈ (r(1 − s/2), r(1 + s/2)) ⊆ (1 − s, 1 + s) (because (1 − s/4)(1 − s/2) > 1 − s and (1 + s/4)(1 + s/2) < 1 + s for 0 < s ≤ 1/4), so for x ∈ Z' this forces x ∈ Z. By 3(b) with b(t, α) := l(t/r)ψ(α): ∫ l(p_1/r)ψ(p_2)H_ℝ(p) dp = ∫_Z l(|x|/r)ψ(f(x))G(x) dμ = ∫ φ dμ with φ(x) := 1_{Z'}(x)l(|x|/r)ψ(f(x))G(x) (bounded, supported in B_2(0), hence μ-integrable). By step 5, ∫ φ dμ = r²∫ φ(ry) dμ(y) = r²∫ 1_{Z'}(y)l(|y|)ψ(f(y))G(ry) dμ(y) = r²∫ 1_{Z'}(y)l(|y|)ψ(f(y))G(y) dμ(y). If y ∈ Z' and l(|y|) ≠ 0 then ||y| − 1| < s/2 < s, so y ∈ Z; thus the last integral is ∫_Z l(|y|)ψ(f(y))G(y) dμ = ∫ l(p_1)ψ(p_2)H_ℝ(p) dp by 3(b). This is (β).
7. (Rigidity.) H_ℝ is integrable on O_s, 0 < s ≤ 1/4 ≤ 1, and (α), (β) hold; the sibling `Submission.idtp_cse_alpha_invariant_homogeneous` gives c ∈ ℝ with H_ℝ(p) = c·p_1 for a.e. p ∈ (1 − s/8, 1 + s/8) × (−s, s). Since H_ℝ ≥ 0 and this set has positive measure with p_1 > 0 on it, c ≥ 0.
8. (c = m.) For 0 < s' ≤ s/8 put Sq(s') := (1 − s', 1 + s') × (−s', s'). Since s' ≤ s, Z ∩ F̃⁻¹(Sq(s')) = Z(s, s'). By step 3 with b := 1_{Sq(s')}: ∫_{Z(s,s')} G dμ = ∫_{Sq(s')} H = ∫_{Sq(s')} ofReal(c·p_1) dp = ofReal(2s'·c·∫_{1−s'}^{1+s'} t dt) = ofReal(4cs'²). Hence (∫_{Z(s,s')} G dμ)/ofReal(s'²) = ofReal(4c) for every s' ∈ (0, s/8]. By the sibling `Submission.idtp_cse_edge_box_mass_limits` (same hypotheses), this quotient tends to 4m as s' → 0⁺; so ofReal(4c) = 4m, and c = m.
9. (Conclusion.) Let s₂ := s/8 > 0. For a.e. p ∈ (1 − s₂, 1 + s₂) × (−s₂, s₂) ⊆ (1 − s/8, 1 + s/8) × (−s, s): H(p) < ∞ and H_ℝ(p) = m·p_1, so H(p) = ofReal(H_ℝ(p)) = ofReal(m·p_1). ∎
proof_key_steps: Loc(s) and μ((spt C)ᶜ) = 0 give the gap hypothesis; sibling rotation_conservation gives ∫_Z ψ'(f)l(|x|)G dμ = 0.
Sibling fibre_area converts every μ-integral ∫_Z b(F̃)G dμ into ∫ b·H; H is integrable and supported in O_s.
Hypothesis (β): cone measure scaling plus sibling tangent_scaling (G(ry) = G(y) μ-a.e.) give ∫ l(t/r)ψ(α)H = r²∫ l(t)ψ(α)H.
Sibling alpha_homogeneous: H = ct a.e. near (1, 0).
∫_{Z(s,s')} G dμ = 4cs'² and sibling box_mass_limits give c = m.
